_comment: Copy this to slskd.local.json and fill it in. That name is gitignored;
this one is not, so never put a real key here.
Used only for hand-testing the slskd integration against a real server.
The app itself never reads this file: it takes the address from Settings
and the API key from the platform keystore.
Generate a key with: openssl rand -base64 48
then add it to slskd.yml under web.authentication.api_keys.
